## About
A & A Automotive & Transmission Repair Inc is a car repair and maintenance shop on County Line Road in Camby, IN. We work on transmissions and the vehicles around them.
Under the A&A Transmissions name we also sell high-performance racing transmission parts. The online catalog covers Chrysler transmissions and engine parts, and you can order online or request a catalog.
Customers have given us a 4.5 rating from 99 Google reviews.

## Services
- Chrysler 727 Trans: Parts for the Chrysler 727 transmission, listed in our online catalog.
- Chrysler 904 Trans: Parts for the Chrysler 904 transmission, listed in our online catalog.
- Chrysler 500/518/618 Trans: Parts for the Chrysler 500, 518 and 618 transmissions, listed in our online catalog.
- Chrysler Engine: Chrysler engine parts, listed in our online catalog.
- 904 Inner 4340 Steel and Stock Outer Gear Set: A gear set for the 904 with a 4340 steel inner and a stock outer.
- Car repair and maintenance: Repair and maintenance work at our shop in Camby.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM EDT. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: When can I call for technical advice?
A: Call our technical advice line Monday through Thursday, between 4:00 PM and 6:00 PM EDT. You can also fax, email or write to us.

Q: Can I get a catalog?
A: Yes. You can download our 2015 catalog from the website or request a catalog.
